reviewer_role: root workflow review with independent read-only integration cross-check

findings.issue: The draft workflow mistakenly changed an existing setup-node action tag from v7 to nonexistent v8.
findings.verification: Official GitHub REST ref/tags/v8 returned404 and commits/v8 returned422; ref/tags/v7 exists at949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1. Baseline replay and current core workflow both already use v7.
findings.resolution: Restore actions/setup-node@v7, retaining Node24 and existing core workflow.

findings.decision: Replay is limited to the already authorized followup branch and repository, with a fixed ancestor; the triggering commit must change only the workflow file against that baseline.

Payload blob identities, compressed and decompressed SHA256, exact file before/after hashes, source path allowlist, unique paths and decompression limits are checked before local source application. Derived files rebuild and must match the locally frozen release-manifest hash.

All21core checks and18browser journeys run on a newly committed clean candidate. Packaging checks the same candidate. A separate named verified branch is created only after full success; the workflow neither merges the DraftPR nor silently promotes its head.

Failed execution keeps its actual logs/history artifact for inspection. Success still requires independent downloaded artifact, nested package, raw source bytes and bundle restoration verification before root can move the followup ref with an expected-SHA lease.

limits: 此记录是工作流审查，不能代替实际GitHub执行。
真实CI运行、最终candidate SHA、产物哈希与原分支推进状态在最终报告及PR列出；不得沿用V7通过状态。
